description: The documented 400 error body for a blocked DELETE /plan/<plan-id> call reads `{"status":400,"msg":"cannot update plan as it is in use by repository: hourlyBackupRepo"}` - the word 'update' in an error raised by a DELETE operation. Either this is a copy-paste artifact from the PUT (edit) code path documented on backup-create-and-edit-plans.md, which shares the same in-use guard, or the underlying API genuinely returns a misleading message for this specific failure. Quoted verbatim in the extraction record rather than silently corrected.
